top_signals.title: Oil Traders Brace for a Wild Week as Brent Approaches $120
top_signals.summary: Fears of renewed U.S.-Iran hostilities are intensifying, with rising Hormuz attacks, reported explosions at Iran's Jask port and military repositioning overshadowing diplomatic efforts. Friday, October 30, 2026 With only several days left until the US midterm elections, oil prices are set for a hefty 13-14% month-on-month increase as ICE Brent trends around $118 per barrel. Qatari and Pakistani mediation notwithstanding, everything is pointing towards a resumption in US-Iran hostilities in the upcoming weeks – rising numbers of Hormuz attacks,…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: St. Louis Fed's Musalem: Another rate hike needed 'soon'
top_signals.summary: Musalem's comments offer the first morsels of insight into what leaders at the Fed see next following this week's decision to hold interst rates steady.

top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 30 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission disbursed €6.1 billion to France, €306 million to Austria, and €92.2 million to Luxembourg.

top_signals.title: Europeans overwhelmingly support stronger EU civil protection cooperation based on solidarity, new Eurobarometer shows
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 30 Oct 2026 Europeans continue to show very strong support for a coordinated European approach to disaster preparedness and response, according to the latest Special Eurobarometer on EU Civil Protection published today by the European Commission.
